constraints: Keep the base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use drupal on one supported Drupal release line.
Confirm the application and its data or configuration work on the target Drupal release; read the vendor's upgrade notes before moving across several release lines.

steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.
steps.title: Update the base image

steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.
steps.title: Align other image references

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container starts on the new base.

rule.replacement: A drupal image on a supported release line
rule.summary: These Drupal release lines no longer receive security fixes from the vendor: the core release schedule ends security support for 10.5 when 11.4 is released, in the week of 2026-06-29, and lists 10.6 as the only supported minor of Drupal 10.
rule.title: Drupal image release lines 10.5 and older are end-of-life
